name: PS5SX2
summary: PCSX2 port with a cover-flow shelf, upscaling, RetroAchievements and patches.
description: A PlayStation 2 emulator built as a native PS5 app. Games load as ISO, CHD, CSO or ZSO from a shelf and can be upscaled with 4K output and FSR. Supports HD texture packs, widescreen/60 FPS patches and the emulated network adapter. Requires your own PS2 BIOS.
author: Swordpdf

firmware.notes: Tester reports across a wide firmware range.

warnings: A helper payload jailbreaks the title at launch.
